name: Table of contents
purpose: Builds a contents list from the h2 and h3 headings in the article. Adds missing heading ids. Stays hidden when the page has fewer headings than the minimum.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: CSS selector of the element that holds the headings.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Smallest number of headings that shows the list.

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: Short id that keeps element ids unique when the item is used twice on one page.

verified_in: headless Chrome/Edge at 360 px and 1280 px
